zone_sol.name: The floor by the pod
zone_sol.description_on_inspect: The metal floor is covered in frost. Looking closer, you notice a dark heap curled up near an air vent: an abandoned lab coat.

zone_bureau.name: The desk at the back
zone_bureau.description_on_inspect: You approach the desk. It is cluttered with severed cables. In the mess you make out a magnetic card encoder, a dead security terminal and an old broken monitor.

zone_mur_gauche.name: The large left wall
zone_mur_gauche.description_on_inspect: Most of the walls are covered in cooling pipes, but a wide section of this wall is completely bare: a single smooth metal plate.

zone_plafond.name: The ceiling and the ducts
zone_plafond.description_on_inspect: Looking up, you see the ventilation system turning sluggishly. One of the ceiling access panels hangs ajar, a length of climbing strap dangling from it.

blouse_scientifique.name: Torn lab coat
blouse_scientifique.description_on_inspect: The coat is stained with dried blood. In the pocket there is a glass vial and a blank card.

mur_metallique.name: The bare metal plate
mur_metallique.description_on_inspect: A plain brushed-metal plate. Its center seems to have been wiped recently, as if to erase something.
mur_metallique.success_message: The liquid reacts instantly. Glowing digits appear: 8-4-2-1.
mur_metallique.fail_message: A plain brushed-metal plate. Its center seems to have been wiped recently.

encodeur_magnetique.name: Card encoder
encodeur_magnetique.success_message: The encoder swallows the blank card with a soft click. Its screen lights up: 'ENTER 4-DIGIT PIN TO ENCODE'.
encodeur_magnetique.fail_message: The device blinks red. It needs a blank card to work.
encodeur_magnetique.pin_success_message: Code accepted. The encoder spits out an encoded level 1 access card.

terminal_securite.name: Security terminal
terminal_securite.success_message: The reader turns green. A heavy mechanism engages somewhere in the room. The door to Corridor A unlocks.
terminal_securite.fail_message: The terminal reads 'ACCESS DENIED'. It needs a valid level 1 access card.

porte_corridor_a.name: Door to Corridor A
porte_corridor_a.description_on_inspect: Your only way out. But first it has to be unlocked from the security terminal.

fiole_uv.name: Vial of luminol
fiole_uv.description_on_inspect: The label reads: 'Luminol reagent. Instantly reveals polymer inks on smooth surfaces.'

carte_vierge.name: Blank magnetic card
carte_vierge.description_on_inspect: A plain white access card with no data on it.

carte_encodee_lvl1.name: Level 1 access card
carte_encodee_lvl1.description_on_inspect: The card has been encoded with level 1 clearance.

sangle_escalade.name: Kevlar climbing strap
sangle_escalade.description_on_inspect: An ultra-strong tactical strap with a hardened steel carabiner.

moniteur_brise.name: Broken monitor
moniteur_brise.description_on_inspect: The CRT screen is completely smashed. Digging through the glass shards, you find nothing but an old sticky note saying 'Buy milk'. Useless.

tuyaux_refroidissement.name: Cooling pipes
tuyaux_refroidissement.description_on_inspect: You run your hand along the pipework. It is covered in thick, solid ice. Something seems embedded in the ice where the two big pipes meet, but there is no freeing it with bare hands.
tuyaux_refroidissement.success_message: The torch flame melts the ice in seconds. A small security key drops to the floor with a metallic clink.
tuyaux_refroidissement.fail_message: You try to scrape the ice, but you only freeze your fingers. You would need a strong, focused heat source.

cle_securite_rouge.name: Red security key
cle_securite_rouge.description_on_inspect: A small metal key with a bright red head. It seems to belong to a control panel.

name: Corridor Sector A
description: A transit junction bathed in a terrifying strobe light. The walls are scarred with what look like plasma burns.

zone_cadavre.name: Shapeless mass in the middle of the corridor
zone_cadavre.description_on_inspect: It is the corpse of a security guard, horribly mutilated. Searching the remains, you find a lighter and, disturbingly, notice that his hand has been cleanly severed but left lying there.

zone_portes.name: The various access doors
zone_portes.description_on_inspect: Behind you is the open door to the cryo room. Ahead, a double door to the Medical Lab, and a huge armored door marked 'Security Airlock'.

briquet.name: Storm lighter
briquet.description_on_inspect: A heavy metal lighter. The flame still works.

main_coupee.name: Guard's severed hand
main_coupee.description_on_inspect: It is grisly, but its biometric prints are still readable.

porte_labo.name: Medical Lab door
porte_labo.description_on_inspect: The door opens easily; the lab's security seems to be down.

porte_sas.name: Security Airlock door
porte_sas.description_on_inspect: Locked. The holographic reader shows 'LEVEL 2 REQUIRED'.
porte_sas.success_message: The level 2 card grants access. The armored door slides heavily aside, revealing the decontamination airlock.

name: Medical Lab
description: The smell of chemicals and rotting flesh is suffocating. Dozens of test tubes lie shattered on the floor.

zone_paillasse.name: The research benches
zone_paillasse.description_on_inspect: The equipment has been wrecked. A single intact bottle stands amid the debris: an aerosol can of highly flammable solvent.

zone_bureau_dir.name: The director's office
zone_bureau_dir.description_on_inspect: A glass-walled office smeared with blood. An 'Access Upgrade Terminal' still blinks inside, asking for biometric validation.

zone_morgue.name: The dark corridor at the back
zone_morgue.description_on_inspect: A battered swinging door reads 'Morgue'. The air there is even colder.

bombe_aerosol.name: Flammable aerosol
bombe_aerosol.description_on_inspect: A can of industrial solvent. Paired with a flame, it would make a fearsome improvised flamethrower.
bombe_aerosol.success_message: You tape the lighter in front of the aerosol nozzle with medical tape. You have just built an improvised blowtorch.

chalumeau_thermique.name: Improvised blowtorch
chalumeau_thermique.description_on_inspect: Very dangerous, but it spits an extremely hot blue flame.

terminal_surclassement.name: Upgrade terminal
terminal_surclassement.description_on_inspect: It can raise the privileges of an existing access card, provided a guard's fingerprint is supplied.
terminal_surclassement.success_message: The biometric scan of the severed hand is accepted. Your profile is upgraded. The terminal issues a level 2 access card.

carte_encodee_lvl2.name: Level 2 access card
carte_encodee_lvl2.description_on_inspect: The pass through the Security Airlock off Corridor A.

name: The Morgue
description: The acoustics in this room are dead. Rows of stainless-steel mortuary drawers line the walls under a crackling black light.

zone_casiers.name: The wall of mortuary drawers
zone_casiers.description_on_inspect: Most are open and horribly empty. But drawer number 13 is bent, jammed from the inside. There is a metal ring to pull it, but with your arms alone it will not budge.

tiroir_coince.name: Jammed mortuary drawer
tiroir_coince.description_on_inspect: Impossible to pull by hand. The metal ring is very solid; you would need to hook onto it and lever with your whole weight.
tiroir_coince.success_message: You clip the strap's carabiner to the ring. Pulling on the strap with all your weight, you burst the drawer open with a crash. Inside, a dead engineer clutches a sonic screwdriver.

tournevis_sonique.name: Sonic screwdriver
tournevis_sonique.description_on_inspect: A cutting-edge tool that forces most maintenance panels by unscrewing their fasteners instantly.

name: Security Airlock
description: A small sealed room. The moment you step in, the doors seal and a yellowish gas starts spraying from the ceiling. CHRONOS watches your vital signs drop.

zone_ventilation_sas.name: The large ceiling vent
zone_ventilation_sas.description_on_inspect: The toxic gas pours out of here. The grille is screwed down tight. If you could open it, you could reach the emergency mechanism to stop the fans.

grille_gaz.name: Gas diffuser grille
grille_gaz.description_on_inspect: Held by round industrial security screws.
grille_gaz.success_message: The sonic screwdriver frees the screws in an instant. You rip the grille away and pull the red emergency lever. The gas stops. The door to Corridor B opens, and you can breathe again.

name: Corridor Sector B
description: This sector is completely wrecked. Smoke creeps across the metal floor. At the far end looms the gigantic door of the generator room.

zone_accès_corridor_b.name: The sector's many doors
zone_accès_corridor_b.description_on_inspect: Three standard doors lead to the Armory, the Hydroponic Greenhouse and the Crew Quarters. And there is the immense hatch to the generators.

porte_generateur.name: Generator Room console
porte_generateur.description_on_inspect: The console demands level 3 clearance to raise the main shield.
porte_generateur.success_message: The card is accepted. The shield rises, revealing the beating heart of the ship.

name: The Armory
description: The weapon racks have been emptied, evidence of a desperate defense. Spent casings lie everywhere.

zone_armoires.name: The tactical maintenance lockers
zone_armoires.description_on_inspect: One of the metal lockers has been smashed in. Inside, among the junk, is some heavy equipment.

pied_de_biche.name: Heavy crowbar
pied_de_biche.description_on_inspect: A huge bar of forged steel. Perfect for forcing anything that resists.

lampe_torche.name: Military flashlight
lampe_torche.description_on_inspect: Its halogen beam would pierce any darkness.

name: Hydroponic Greenhouse
description: The place is plunged into absolute darkness and smells of rotting soil. The humidity is crushing.

zone_vegetation.name: The mass of vegetation in the dark
zone_vegetation.description_on_inspect: You shine your flashlight. The plants have mutated and barricade access to a computer console at the back of the room. Their vines are as thick as steel cables.

plantes_mutantes.name: Barricade of mutant plants
plantes_mutantes.description_on_inspect: They are alive and react to light. They would have to be destroyed to get through.
plantes_mutantes.success_message: The torch's fire chars the mutant vegetation amid a horrible vegetal shriek. The console is clear, and on it you find a level 3 access card!

carte_encodee_lvl3.name: Level 3 access card
carte_encodee_lvl3.description_on_inspect: Maximum clearance. The key to the generator.

name: Crew Quarters
description: A cramped dormitory. The bunk beds are overturned, personal belongings scattered. A tragic silence reigns here.

zone_casiers_perso.name: The row of personal lockers
zone_casiers_perso.description_on_inspect: Most are open. But the Captain's locker is still sealed with a sturdy mechanical lock.

casier_capitaine.name: Captain's locker
casier_capitaine.description_on_inspect: Thick metal, impossible to open without serious leverage.
casier_capitaine.success_message: You wedge in the crowbar and force it. The metal gives with a loud CRACK. Inside is the captain's logbook.

journal_de_bord.name: Holographic logbook
journal_de_bord.description_on_inspect: An audio recording plays on a loop: 'If they reach the generator, we are dead. I hid the Red Survival Key in the cryogenics system, embedded in the ice of the main pipes.'

name: Generator Room
description: A colossal cavern of engineering. A giant digital countdown ticks off the last minutes of oxygen. This is where it all comes down.

zone_console_centrale.name: The central control pillar
zone_console_centrale.description_on_inspect: A dust-covered console. At its center, a triangular slot that takes a red hardware security key.

console_finale.name: Emergency key slot
console_finale.description_on_inspect: The manual restart system for life support.
console_finale.success_message: You insert the red key and turn it. The giant turbines roar to life. Fresh air bursts from the vents. CHRONOS murmurs 'System anomaly... shutting down' before going dark. You survived.
